name: command-line-series-motion
description: فيديو ترويجي عمودي (9:16) لسلسلة سطر الأوامر، مبني بـ Remotion

scripts.preview: npm run prepare-assets && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render src/index.ts Promo out/command-line-series-promo-vertical.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 --pixel-format=yuv420p --color-space=bt709 --audio-codec=aac --concurrency=50%
scripts.render:preview: ffmpeg -y -i out/command-line-series-promo-vertical.mp4 -vf scale=540:960:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -crf 26 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 96k -movflags +faststart out/command-line-series-promo-preview-540p.mp4
scripts.render:descent: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render src/index.ts Descent out/command-line-series-descent-vertical.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 --pixel-format=yuv420p --color-space=bt709 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=320k --concurrency=50%
scripts.render:descent:preview: ffmpeg -y -i out/command-line-series-descent-vertical.mp4 -vf scale=540:960:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -crf 26 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 128k -movflags +faststart out/command-line-series-descent-preview-540p.mp4
scripts.music: node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/export-plan.ts && python3 scripts/score.py && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/descent-score-raw.wav -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.2:LRA=11,aresample=48000 -c:a pcm_s16le public/audio/descent-score.wav
